PricingTier.description: An enumeration of the different pricing tiers.
PricingTier.title: PricingTier

description:
A customer scenario describes a specific situation or 
context in which a customer interacts with a product or service.

channel_type.description: The channel through which the customer interacts with the product or service.
channel_type.title: Channel Type

empathy_map_id.description: Identifier of the empathy map this customer scenario is associated with.
empathy_map_id.title: Empathy Map Id

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer scenario.
id.title: Id

interdependence_signal.description: Indicates whether there is a signal of interdependence in this customer scenario.
interdependence_signal.title: Interdependence Signal

open_questions.description: A list of open-ended questions that arise from this customer scenario.
examples: How can we improve the online ordering experience for busy professionals?
open_questions.title: Open Questions

pricing_tier.description: The pricing tier relevant to this customer scenario, if applicable.

relationship_type.description: The type of relationship the customer has with the business in this scenario.
relationship_type.title: Relationship Type

situation_narrative.description: A narrative describing the situation or context of the customer scenario.
examples: A busy professional trying to order groceries online during a hectic workday.
situation_narrative.title: Situation Narrative

title: CustomerScenario
